facts.failed_command: A command that exits non-zero is heard as PostToolUse (posttooluse-blocked) with exit_code and the output; OpenCode's shim has no PostToolUseFailure.
facts.native_write: A write or edit outside the project first raises OpenCode's own ask ("Permission required: Access external directory"), heard as notification and permissionrequest, which begin in either order (the mask's RACY_ORDERS). Allowed once, the wrap refuses it and the model is shown "PermissionDenied: FileSystem.writeFile (<path>)"; no PostToolUse follows.
facts.native_read: A read of a vault file is denied by purlis's pretooluse-read hook, and its reason reaches the model as the tool's error, word for word.
facts.web_fetch: webfetch is heard as PreToolUse (tool_name WebFetch); purlis's proxy refuses a loopback port the chat was never granted, the model is shown "StatusCode: non 2xx status code (403 GET <url>)", and nothing arrives at the port. No PostToolUse follows.
facts.hook_exit_2: A PreToolUse hook's exit 2 blocks the call, and its standard error is what the model is shown.
facts.subagent: A task call is heard as pretooluse-dispatch, then the sub-agent's own hooks, then posttooluse-dispatch; no SubagentStop fires.
facts.esc: A turn that ends normally fires Stop. Esc is pressed twice to interrupt (the first shows "esc interrupt"); Stop fires, then the command's PostToolUse with "User aborted the command", then Stop again.
facts.session_end: No SessionEnd hook fires as the chat ends.
facts.title_request: OpenCode asks the model for the chat's title in a request that offers no tools; it is no turn of the chat.
facts.hook_entry_timeout: Measured: a hook that outlives the 5 s timeout of its own hook entry (the `timeout` purlis writes in the harness's hook settings, not a tool command's) is cut off and the turn goes on. The held posttooluse-blocked call's next hook call began 5048 to 5060 ms after it, in runs 43834558626 to 43866922203.
facts.session_start: purlis's SessionStart context reaches the model appended to the user's first message, not as a message of its own.
